Existing Apps Script core recovered from the saved independent p13 source readback of 2 November 2026. This is a test fixture, not another backend or a deployable bundle. `source-sha256.json` fingerprints the unchanged core files; Config has only synthetic resource IDs. No credentials, members, bank statements, .clasp files or real CRM data are included.

The reused Apps Script test harness loads these functions plus the existing PR128 extensions. Sheets, MailApp, CalendarApp, DriveApp, CacheService, clocks and locks are in-memory test services. Only explicitly labelled future-release tests substitute the disabled adapter constant inside their isolated VM. The default source remains paused. Integration PASS is not Google authorization, a hosted staging deployment, email delivery or a Fio bank readback.
